analysis: The supplied units are base-side excerpts of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (lines 1179-1982). The PR is documentation-only; the patch excerpt shows changes to the sandbox row (line 182), a new line near 191, rewritten setup step text (head 1360-1385), and a new head range 1635-1724. I examined the base text for the sandbox setup path against TB-013, T-061 and A-019. It describes the CLI downloading install.sh over HTTPS only, enforcing 200, a 1 MiB cap and a shell shebang, storing it 0600 in a 0700 directory, and relying on the installer for release verification. The patch adds a statement that setup requires approval from the Darkbloom Sandbox waitlist. That is an operational gating statement, not a new trust path. The head text for most changed ranges is not supplied, so I could not verify whether the documented controls (TLS-only script trust, ownership-off disk remediation via sudo diskutil in the foreground process group, no password reading by the CLI) were weakened. The head 1635-1724 range appears to add stop/restart/cluster-related text, but its content is truncated and unseen. No concrete security regression is evident from the visible base text and patch excerpt. The base text also covers the Date-comparison/weak-import note, the uninstall flow and the status/traffic semantics, none of which the visible patch alters. Remaining integration question: the head-side docs for the setup, waitlist and new 1635-1724 sections should be checked against the actual code (SandboxInstaller, SandboxWorkDisk) for consistency with T-061 and T-062 mitigations. Because the head text is unavailable, a deeper look is warranted.
